title: audio
description: A sequence's audio tracks (WP12): voice lines from a timing document, or clips at frames. Converged by audio.lines / audio.place / audio.remove.

remove_others.description: remove audio tracks the spec does not list

name.description: the audio track's display name (VO, Music, SFX)

timing.description: a timing document (kind timing): path relative to the working directory, or inline

wav_root.description: box folder the timing's relative wav paths are under

folder.description: where the lines' SoundWaves are imported

start_frame.description: first frame, at the sequence's display rate

end_frame.description: end frame (exclusive); default: the sound's end

offset_s.description: seconds into the sound the clip starts
